decode: arg0=utf8
arg0 is loginusers.vdf as src/main/launchers/steam/adapter.ts reads it: readLauncherText(path, MAX_VDF_BYTES) (readFileSync then toString utf8) or readFileSync(path, utf8); both keep a BOM and turn invalid bytes into U+FFFD. arg1 is the target SteamID64.
Global state: every call hands the account and persona names it found to redactAccountNames (src/main/services/logger.ts), which adds them to the logger’s module-level redaction list; the result does not depend on that list and the generator never resets it. (planAutoLoginRewrite calls parseLoginUsers first.)
The byte-exact rewriter: out.text is the whole new file, compared as a string. Errors: LoginUsersFormatError (code LOGINUSERS_FORMAT) for a target not among the parsed users, and whatever parseLoginUsers throws.
Bases of the corpus: seed 31 the fixture, its CRLF copy and its BOM copy with target 76561198000000003; seed 32 the MostRecent CRLF literal with target 76561198000000002; seed 33 the fixture and the synonyms literal with target 76561198000000001; seed 34 the fixture, its CRLF copy and the MostRecent literal with target 76561198000000002, line, EOL, BOM, astral and invalid-UTF-8 mutations only, so more of them parse.
No corpus case was dropped.

other: the format error of parseLoginUsers propagates
utf8-decode: a lone 0xFF byte in an account name; Node decodes it to U+FFFD and the rewritten text carries U+FFFD
other: a block with AutoLogin and MostRecent gets both set
case-mapping: MOST_RECENT_LINE has the i flag: autologin and MOSTRECENT lines are rewritten with their own spelling
case-mapping: the i flag without u does not fold U+017F (long s) to s, so "Moſtrecent" is not a synonym and the block gets an AutoLogin line; a Unicode case-insensitive match would take it
other: a value of "1 " is not "1", so it is rewritten to "1" for the target, keeping the trailing whitespace of the line
other: an inserted line copies the indent and separator of the last key line seen, here four spaces and one space
other: indent and separator carry over from an earlier block when a block has no plain key line (its only value holds an escaped quote)
other: with no plain key line anywhere before it, the inserted line uses two tabs and two tabs
other: an AutoLogin line with a trailing comment is not recognised, so a second AutoLogin is inserted and the parser takes the last one
other: an opening brace with a trailing comment is not counted, so the blocks below it are seen one level too shallow and nothing is rewritten
other: a file on one line has no line that is only a brace, so the plan is a no-op although the target is not flagged
other: a block opened on the key line ("id" {) is not counted either
other: keys inside a block nested in a user block are left alone, and its closing brace inserts nothing
other: a block parseLoginUsers skips (no AccountName) is still rewritten to 0 and gets an AutoLogin line if it has none
other: when the target id appears twice, both of its blocks are set to 1
other: one CRLF anywhere makes every line end in CRLF on output, LF lines included
other: with mixed line endings and nothing to change the plan says noop although its text differs from the input
other: lone CR line endings are one line to the rewriter, so nothing changes
other: a file without a final newline gets none
unicode-space: U+FEFF counts as \s in USER_KEY_LINE and is stripped by trim(), so a user key line or brace line led by U+FEFF still counts; Rust \s and str::trim do not treat U+FEFF as whitespace
unicode-space: MOST_RECENT_LINE uses \s: NBSP and U+3000 between key and value cannot appear outside quotes (parseVdf never returns), but U+FEFF can
other: a 20-digit target is recognised by USER_KEY_LINE
other: a 21-digit id is not a user, so it is refused as a target
utf16-length: astral characters elsewhere in the file pass through unchanged
